description: This file manages session state persistence for a QQ bot, including loading, saving with throttling, clearing, updating, and cleaning up expired sessions. It defines the SessionState interface, handles filesystem interactions, and maintains in-memory throttle state.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures the session directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getSessionPath
methods.description: Generates the file path for a session based on accountId.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads a session from disk, validating expiration and appId match.

methods.name: saveSession
methods.description: Saves session state to disk with throttling to limit disk writes.

methods.name: doSaveSession
methods.description: Immediately writes a session state to disk.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Deletes a session file and cancels any pending save throttling.

methods.name: updateLastSeq
methods.description: Updates only the lastSeq value of a session on disk.

methods.name: getAllSessions
methods.description: Retrieves all saved sessions from disk.

methods.name: cleanupExpiredSessions
methods.description: Removes expired session files from disk.
